notes.title: Pregnant is turning Free to Play
notes.notes:
Hi!

I want to say thanks to all of the people who have bought and tried Pregnant, the feedback i have gotten is invaluable and i have learned a lot. 

Pregnant is my first game ever and my first time publishing a game, a big learning experience for sure and very exciting.
I have decided not to expand or alter Pregnant further since i am working on a new game, and therefore i feel it is the right decision to change the game to be free to play. 

Again, thank you to everyone who has supported me by trying out Pregnant and i hope you will like my upcoming project.

Best Regards,
Cardlakefiction

notes.title: Launch Day Update
notes.notes: Tweaked the sound mix for the entire game, lowered jumpscares and other loud sounds to be more in line with the rest of the game audio.
